info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Event Cancellation API
info.description: The Webhook Event Cancellation API facilitates the removal of specific event notifications associated with a given webhook. This endpoint allows users to manage their webhook subscriptions by deleting targeted events that are no longer needed. Typical consumers include application developers who need to maintain accurate and relevant webhook data for their applications. With this functionality, developers can streamline their notification processes and ensure optimal resource utilization.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific webhook event identified by its unique ID. Ensure that you confirm the action as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This payload is used to delete the specified event associated with the webhook. Please ensure that the correct event ID is provided in the request to successfully process the deletion.

204.description: Successful deletion with no content returned.

DeleteWebhookEventRes100045Request.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the DELETE operation on the events resource for the given webhook.

DeleteWebhookEventRes100045Response_204.description: Response schema for a successful deletion operation in the webhook system.

x-endpoint-id.description: A unique identifier for the webhook endpoint that is being referenced in the response.

x-runtime-app.description: The name of the runtime application that processed the webhook event, providing context for the request.

bearerAuth.description: This authentication method uses the Bearer scheme, allowing clients to authenticate via a JSON Web Token (JWT). The JWT must be included in the `Authorization` header of the HTTP request, formatted as `Bearer <token>`. This ensures secure access to protected resources.
